title: Book One · Chapter 181: The Blue Bike
story:
The blue bike stands inside the gate.

There is no ribbon on it. There is no new paint. One side has a long scratch near the back wheel.

Ronan walks round it.

The woman waits. A girl comes out of the house behind her. She is taller than Ronan.

“It used to be mine,” she says.

“Do you still ride it?”

“My knees are too high now.”

She sits on it for a moment and shows him. Then she gets off.

Ronan touches the seat.

Dad asks the woman before he checks the bike. He looks at the wheels and the brakes. He moves it slowly, stops, and checks again.

Ronan watches his hands.

“This part needs work,” Dad says. He points to one brake.

“It stops,” the girl says.

“It does. But the pad is very worn.”

The woman comes closer.

“I did not know.”

Dad points to the brake. He shows her the thin brake pad. Only one part needs work. The other parts may be fine. Dad checks them too.

Mum asks about the price. She and the woman talk quietly. Then Mum calls Ronan over.

“She can take a little less. We can use that part of the money for the brake.”

Ronan looks from Mum to Dad.

“Is the rest all right?”

“We will know more when you try it. We can hold it while you sit.”

The seat is a little high. Dad asks to change it. Dad asks for a tool. The woman brings it.

Soon, Ronan can put his feet down.

He holds the handlebars. They feel strange after so much waiting.

Dad keeps one hand on the seat.

“Just a little way. Slowly.”

Ronan pushes with one foot. Then he puts it on the pedal.

The bike moves.

For a long time, he wanted to ride again. He often thought about it. Now he must look ahead and move the pedals. The wheels make little sounds. This seat feels different from the old one.

Ronan stops. Dad is still beside him.

“Again?”

He goes a little farther this time. Then he turns back.

Mum stands by the gate. She is not telling him to smile.

“What do you think?” she asks.

Ronan looks at the scratch. He looks at the wheels and his hands on the bars.

“I like it.”

“Do you want this one, or do you want to wait?”

He thinks about that.

For a long time, Ronan wanted his red bike back. He often thought of it under the tree at their old home. But Bo uses that bike now.

This bike is blue.

He moves it forward and back.

“This one,” he says.

Mum opens the envelope. Ronan gives the money to the woman. She counts the money. Then she gives him his change.

The girl looks at the bike once more.

“I hope you like it.”

“Thank you.”

Ronan takes the bell from his pocket.

“This is from my old one.”

The girl presses it. The sound is small and bright.

“That is a good bell.”

On the way home, Dad walks the bike. They will do the work before Ronan rides it properly.

Ronan walks on the other side. Now and then, he touches one handlebar.

At the narrow corner, he goes ahead. He looks along the path. It is clear.

Then he holds the green gate open.

“Here,” he says. “This is its place.”
studyGuide:
## 重点表达
- brake：刹车。
- worn：磨损的。
- pedal：脚踏板。
- properly：妥当地、正常地。

## 理解
1. 一家人在付款前做了哪些确认？
2. Ronan为什么最后选择这辆蓝车？
